== LLG 2019 Annual Meeting Minutes ==

Minutes for this meeting have not yet been compiled or reviewed, but here is an unofficial summary of some significant details. A [[LLG 2019 Annual Meeting Transcript|transcript of the meeting channel]] is available.

The meeting was called to order by president Karen Stein on October 20, 2019 and adjourned May 5, 2020.
